title: Buddy Sali, the drummer who hit Joe Oliver
summary: Vincent confirms that drummer Buddy Sali was the one who hit Joe Oliver. Sali played a while afterward but died young of consumption.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Buddy Salo. Buddy Salo? Yeah. That's the one that hit Joe Lewis. Joe Oliver. Yeah. And what Joe Lewis? Joe Oliver. Oliver. Joe Oliver.
Ask him, did he play after that?
Did we play after that? He come down there, you know, and play a little while. He didn't live long. He went into consumption, you know.
